story.iWant: a script that reads wiki articles, embeds them via Voyage AI, and upserts nodes+edges into Memgraph
story.soThat: the knowledge graph in Memgraph stays synchronized with the wiki files

task.title: Create graph-sync.mjs with CLI argument parsing
task.subtask: Create /home/ubuntu/scripts/graph-sync.mjs
Parse CLI arguments: --project {projectId}, --knowledge-dir {path}, --state-file {path} (defaults to {knowledge-dir}/../.mycelium/compile-state.json)
Parse optional --full-resync flag
Validate required arguments and provide usage help if missing

task.title: Implement content hash diffing
task.subtask: Read compile-state.json — a map of { "article-path": "content-hash" }
Scan all .md files in knowledge/ recursively (excluding archive/)
For each article, compute MD5 hash of article body (excluding frontmatter date fields to avoid unnecessary re-embeds)
Compare current hash against stored hash — identify new, changed, and deleted articles
If --full-resync flag is set, treat all articles as changed regardless of hash
Log: [graph-sync] Found {n} new, {m} changed, {d} deleted articles

task.title: Parse article frontmatter and wikilinks
task.subtask: Parse YAML frontmatter from each article (title, type, phase, status, maturity, tags, createdByEpic, createdByStory, lastMutatedByStory, created, updated)
Extract [[wikilinks]] from article body sections

Map wikilinks to edge types based on section heading: ## Dependencies -> DEPENDS_ON (outgoing), ## Dependents -> DEPENDS_ON (incoming/reverse), ## Derived From -> DERIVED_FROM, ## Informs -> INFORMS, ## Validates -> VALIDATES, ## Supersedes -> SUPERSEDES, ## Conflicts With -> CONFLICTS_WITH (bidirectional), ## Enables -> ENABLES
Store parsed wikilink targets and their corresponding edge types

task.title: Embed changed articles via Voyage AI
task.subtask: Import embedBatch from lib/voyage-embed.mjs
Prepare text for embedding: concatenate article title + purpose section + key exports (first 500 tokens representative content)
Batch embed all changed articles using embedBatch(texts, 'document')
Associate each returned embedding with its article
Log embedding stats: [graph-sync] Embedded {n} articles, {tokens} tokens, ~${cost}

task.title: Upsert nodes into Memgraph
task.subtask: Connect to Memgraph via bolt://localhost:7687 using neo4j-driver
For each changed article, execute MERGE + SET with all frontmatter properties and embedding vector
For deleted articles (hash present in state but file removed), set status: pruned on the node
Log: [graph-sync] Upserted {n} nodes, pruned {d} nodes

task.title: Create/update edges from wikilinks
task.subtask: For each article's parsed wikilinks, MERGE edges with correct type and weight
Handle incoming edges (## Dependents creates edges pointing TO the current node)
Handle bidirectional edges (CONFLICTS_WITH creates edges in both directions)
Remove stale edges for deleted wikilinks
Assign correct weight per edge type from architecture doc
Log: [graph-sync] Created/updated {n} edges, removed {d} stale edges

task.title: Update compile-state.json
task.subtask: After successful upsert, write updated hash map to compile-state.json
Remove entries for deleted articles
Use atomic write (write to temp file then rename) to prevent corruption on crash

task.title: End-to-end validation
task.subtask: Create 3 test wiki articles with frontmatter and wikilinks
Run graph-sync.mjs — verify all 3 nodes created in Memgraph with embeddings
Verify edges created from wikilinks
Modify one article — run again — verify only the changed article is re-embedded
Run with --full-resync — verify all articles are re-processed
Delete one article — run again — verify node is marked as pruned
Clean up test data

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The script reads .mycelium/compile-state.json for content hashes of the last sync
The script identifies new or changed articles by comparing current content hashes against stored hashes
For each changed article: embeds via Voyage AI and upserts node in Memgraph with all frontmatter properties + embedding vector
The script parses [[wikilinks]] from article sections (Dependencies, Dependents, etc.) and creates/updates typed edges in Memgraph
The script updates compile-state.json with new hashes after successful sync
The script supports a --full-resync flag that re-processes all articles regardless of hash

doc.snippet: D1: Wiki markdown as persistence, D9: Wiki as source of truth, Memgraph rebuilt from wiki at any time.

constraints.constraint: Story MY-1.2 must be complete — Memgraph schema and vector index must be initialized before graph-sync can upsert
Story MY-1.3 must be complete — wiki directory structure must exist to have articles to scan
Story MY-1.4 must be complete — voyage-embed.mjs module must be available for embedding
Incremental by default — only re-embeds changed articles to minimize Voyage AI cost (~$0.003 per story compilation)
Atomic state file writes — write to temp file then rename to prevent compile-state.json corruption on crash
MD5 hash excludes frontmatter date fields (created, updated) to avoid unnecessary re-embeds when only timestamps change
Archive directory excluded from scanning — articles in knowledge/archive/ are not synced
Edge weight values must exactly match architecture doc: DEPENDS_ON=1.0, DERIVED_FROM=0.7, INFORMS=0.3, REFINES=0.5, VALIDATES=0.6, SUPERSEDES=0.8, CONFLICTS_WITH=0.9, ENABLES=0.5

interface.name: graph-sync.mjs CLI
interface.details: Arguments: --project {projectId} (required), --knowledge-dir {path} (required), --state-file {path} (optional, defaults to {knowledge-dir}/../.mycelium/compile-state.json), --full-resync (optional flag). Called by daemon shell steps in compilation pipelines.

interface.name: Memgraph Bolt Protocol
interface.details: MERGE + SET for node upserts with all frontmatter properties and embedding vector. MERGE for edge creation/updates. DELETE for stale edge removal.

interface.name: Voyage AI embedBatch
interface.details: embedBatch(texts, 'document') returns number[][] (N x 1024-dim). Called with article content for embedding before Memgraph upsert.

interface.name: compile-state.json
interface.details: Map of { "article-relative-path": "md5-content-hash" }. Read at start for diffing, written at end after successful sync. Located at {workingDir}/.mycelium/compile-state.json.

interface.name: Cypher — Node Upsert
interface.query: MERGE (n:Node {nodeId: $nodeId}) SET n.projectId = $projectId, n.type = $type, n.phase = $phase, n.status = $status, n.maturity = $maturity, n.title = $title, n.summary = $summary, n.tags = $tags, n.createdByEpic = $createdByEpic, n.createdByStory = $createdByStory, n.lastMutatedByStory = $lastMutatedByStory, n.created = $created, n.updated = $updated, n.embedding = $embedding

standards.standard: End-to-end validation with real Memgraph instance and test wiki articles
Incremental sync validation — modify one article, verify only that article is re-embedded
Full resync validation — verify --full-resync flag processes all articles
Deletion handling — remove article file, verify node status set to pruned
Edge derivation — verify wikilinks in article sections produce correct edge types and directions

ideas.idea: Create compile-state.json with known hashes, run graph-sync, verify it reads and uses those hashes for diffing
Create 3 articles, run graph-sync, verify 3 reported as new. Modify 1, run again, verify 1 changed + 2 unchanged
After sync, query Memgraph: MATCH (n:Node) WHERE n.projectId = $testProject RETURN n — verify all frontmatter properties and embedding present on each node
Create article with ## Dependencies containing [[code/other-file]], run sync, verify DEPENDS_ON edge exists from article node to other-file node. Test all 8 edge type mappings.
After sync, read compile-state.json — verify it contains hashes for all synced articles
Run with --full-resync — verify all articles processed even if hashes unchanged
Run without --project — verify usage help printed and non-zero exit code
